description: Unit test class for testing the Order total calculation in the eShopOnWeb application, specifically testing the Order aggregate's Total() method with different item configurations.

classes.name: OrderTotal
classes.description: Test class containing unit tests for the Order entity's Total() method.

methods.name: IsZeroForNewOrder
methods.description: Tests that the total of a new order with no items is zero.

methods.name: IsCorrectGiven1Item
methods.description: Tests that the total for an order with a single item equals the unit price.

methods.name: IsCorrectGiven3Items
methods.description: Tests that the total for an order with multiple items matches the expected total based on unit price and quantity.
